release_schedule.note: NSI Bulgaria's quarterly national accounts (GDP, ESA 2010) 'flash estimates' press release is issued about 43-45 days after each quarter ends, consistently around the 13th-14th of Feb/May/Aug/Nov: Q2 2025 -> 14 Aug 2025; Q3 2025 -> 14 Nov 2025; Q4 2025 -> 13 Feb 2026; Q1 2026 -> 13 May 2026. No published fixed-date calendar or statutory rule was found (NSI's interactive Release Calendar at nsi.bg/en/calendar does not expose static dated entries to fetch), so the next dates below are projected from this consistent pattern, not read off a calendar. NSI also publishes 'preliminary data' (fuller, ~10 weeks after quarter end) and annual/detailed national accounts data separately; this schedule tracks the quarterly flash-estimate series, which matches the on-file releases_per_year=4 cadence.

release_schedule.note: CyStat's 'Quarterly National Accounts' release (the ESA2010-based national accounts announcement) appears in CyStat's official Release Calendar (Oct 2025-Dec 2026, last updated 07/08/2026), which is refreshed every Friday. Past pattern confirms 4 releases/year, roughly ~3 months after quarter-end: Q3 2025 released 2025-12-01, Q4 2025 released 2026-03-02, Q1 2026 released 2026-06-02, and upcoming Q2 2026 scheduled 2026-09-01 (status 'Preliminary' at time of check, i.e. not yet finalized to a 'Confirmed' date but on the published calendar) and Q3 2026 scheduled 2026-12-01. Separately, CyStat also issues a faster 'GDP Growth Rate (Flash Estimate)' ~6-8 weeks after quarter-end (e.g. next one confirmed for 2026-08-14, covering Q2 2026) which is a related but distinct announcement from the full Quarterly National Accounts release.

release_schedule.rule: First estimate published 50 days after the end of the reference quarter; revised version published 90 days after the end of the quarter; annual accounts released in late February alongside the Q4 publication.
release_schedule.note: Statistics Denmark's National Accounts is compiled at both quarterly and annual periodicity under separate documentation pages. The corpus's releases_per_year=4 matches the QUARTERLY national accounts (four quarterly GDP/national-accounts releases per year, each ~50 days after quarter end per DST's own documentation page 'National Accounts: Quarterly'), not the ANNUAL national accounts documentation page currently linked in the url field (which states periodicity 'Annual'). The 2026-08-20 date is the documented next release ('Quarterly Real Growth in GDP') read directly off DST's statistic landing page; the 2026-11-19 date is computed by applying DST's own stated 50-days-after-quarter-end rule to Q3 2026 and is therefore marked implied. A separate annual GDP/national-accounts release is scheduled for 2027-02-22 per the same page.

release_schedule.rule: Starting from May 2026, national accounts (annual, quarterly, and quarterly sector accounts combined into one set of statistics) are released eight times a year: quarterly national accounts data are released within two months after the end of the quarter (i.e. in February, May, August and November), and quarterly sector accounts data follow approximately two weeks later (March, June, September and December). Final annual figures are completed in December once supply and use tables are finalised.
release_schedule.note: Confirmed publication cadence via Statistics Finland's own documentation page (dokumentaatio/ntp) and by cross-checking actual past releases: Q4 2025 data released 27 Feb 2026, Q1 2026 data released 29 May 2026 (both ~2 months after quarter end), consistent with the stated rule. Exact day-of-release for the Aug/Sep 2026 editions was not published as a fixed date on the site (release calendar section is JS-rendered and not readable via fetch), so entries use month precision.

Quarterly first-estimate GDP/national accounts releases occur ~2 months after quarter-end, consistently on the last Wed/Thu of Feb, May, Aug, Nov (confirmed historical dates: 27 Aug 2025 for Q2 2025, 27 Nov 2025 for Q3 2025, 27 Feb 2026 for Q4 2025, 28 May 2026 for Q1 2026), matching the on-file releases_per_year=4. Next release (Q2 2026, code NR-2026-1-1/2) has planned date 27 Aug 2026 per the publisher's own calendar table, still upcoming relative to today (2026-08-11). DZS also separately publishes an Annual GDP release (~once/year, e.g. planned 16 Oct 2026 for NR-2026-2-2) and other national-accounts-adjacent products (investments, regional accounts, sector accounts) on different cadences; this schedule tracks only the quarterly first-estimate series, consistent with the existing releases_per_year=4.
